PM Modi to Visit Australia Amidst Strengthening India-Australia Ties

Prime Minister Narendra Modi is undertaking a six-day tour of Indonesia, Australia, and New Zealand to strengthen India's Act East Policy and Indo-Pacific vision. Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has stated that India-Australia relations are 'never been more consequential' ahead of Modi's visit. Discussions are expected to focus on defense, critical minerals, and strategic partnerships, with Australia probing an online threat against PM Modi.
